name: Polebrook Hall

layers.essential_history: [[c:Polebrook Hall is the village's manor house. It is private, so please look from the road.]]
layers.deeper_history: [[c:In the war, big houses near airfields were often used by officers.]]
layers.mystery: [[c:Hank the airman says he was on duty at the airfield all night. The duty roster backs him up.]]

evidence: [[c:Sergeant Miller was on duty at the airfield all night.]]
directions_to_next: [[c:Head east, about 130 metres as the crow flies, to the village school.  Keep to pavements and public paths.]]
